old_problem: The item names the PDB domain while the procedure filters only `TEMP_PDB`; the source does not say whether that is the entire intended sensor namespace or a thermal subset. Exact PDB/PSU/feed/rail/channel semantics and scaling are OEM/project data. Historical review escalated those parameter bindings and the 1/2/21 numbering gap instead of defining a complete Project-SPEC-driven reconciliation.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict. The standard read-only method is complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor collection plus Web evidence. A versioned Project SPEC defines every PDB instance, feed/rail/channel and whether `TEMP_PDB` is complete or which voltage/current/power-good/fault companions are required. This is permissible Project Configuration under ED-03/36 and prevents scope guessing. Passive power/redundancy context is evidence only; no power action is authorized. Criteria 1/2/21 are preserved and unwritten numbers are not invented.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2018, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, ED-01 through ED-30 and ipmitool/OpenBMC documentation were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2019 / Wistron-BMC-01039-V002 / b0bc960c1ef22e93.
IPMI supports complete sensor enumeration, while PDB labels, rails, scaling and expected electrical/thermal ranges are OEM platform mappings that must be supplied by exact board revision.
Full raw inventories before filtering allow the approved namespace to determine whether TEMP_PDB is complete, partial, renamed or absent and prevent thermal-only false coverage.
Every PDB, PSU feed, rail/channel/load and aggregate sensor scope must be explicit; N/A is allowed only with SPEC-proven non-applicability.
Only SDR, Sensor List and Web SPEC parity are written; number 21 remains a formatting defect and cannot create criteria 3–20.
No ipmitool, authentication, PDB/power sensor read, Web login/capture, feed/rail/PSU action, log clear, BMC, host or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: PDB/PSU-feed/rail sensor namespace parity across complete IB/OOB IPMI and BMC Web
test_case.purpose: For every installed PDB and Project-SPEC-defined PSU feed, rail/channel/load domain, verify the complete applicable sensor namespace—including TEMP_PDB and required companions—matches identity, scaling, reading and state across IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web.
required_package: Exact SUT/BMC/PDB part/revision/serial/location and installed PSU/feed/rail/channel/load/redundancy topology

Versioned PDB sensor namespace SPEC stating whether TEMP_PDB is complete/partial and enumerating temperature, voltage, current, power, power-good/fault companions, units/scaling/ranges/states/thresholds/freshness
Approved ipmitool, trusted protected OOB/Web access, aligned sampling plus load/cache/rounding/stale/unavailable/pagination rules
Passive voltage/current/power/redundancy/thermal stop limits, complete evidence hashes, preserved logs and independent power escalation
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; bind exact PDB revision and power-distribution topology, record stable load/redundancy state and preserve logs. Capture complete untruncated IB and OOB `sdr elist`/`sensor list` at aligned times; retain raw data before applying the approved PDB namespace and TEMP_PDB view. Capture all BMC Web Sensor pages with exact PDB/feed/rail identity and timestamps. Compare complete population plus name/description/type/unit/scaling/reading/state/threshold/freshness with SPEC and across views; correlate passive power/redundancy context only. Never assume TEMP_PDB is full scope, use the testcase title as a sensor, rely on grep/head alone, switch feeds/rails/PSUs, clear logs or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every applicable PDB/feed/rail/channel domain has exactly its SPEC-required individual or aggregate records; TEMP_PDB and companions bind correctly, all IB/OOB/Web fields and readings/states agree within version/load rules, passive redundancy remains healthy and no disallowed power/thermal/log alarm appears.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact topology/revision/load context, complete raw IB/OOB and visual Web evidence, complete unique namespace coverage and every required scaled value/state within SPEC/freshness rules. FAIL on unjustified thermal-only scope/N/A, missing/extra/duplicate/misattributed rail, wrong scaling/unit/state/threshold, stale/out-of-range value, cross-view mismatch, redundancy loss/alarm or incomplete evidence. Missing namespace/SPEC is NOT READY; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive read-only only; prohibit feed/rail/PSU switching, power control, BMC/sensor/threshold writes and log clearing.
Require exact PDB revision/topology and complete Project namespace after full raw capture; protect credentials.
Stop on identity ambiguity, missing/duplicate mapping, voltage/current/power/temperature/fault alarm or redundancy loss.
No automatic retry; preserve first discrepancy, complete Web evidence and power/BMC/host logs.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant and SUT/BMC/PDB part-revision-serial/location plus PSU/feed/rail/channel/load topology
Complete Project namespace with TEMP_PDB scope, companion records, scaling/ranges and five-view crosswalk
Complete timestamped IB/OOB SDR elist and Sensor list raw outputs, exits and hashes
Complete BMC Web screenshots/export with PDB/feed/rail binding and pagination
Passive load/redundancy/power/thermal context, numbering-defect/no-power-action/no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong target/revision, access, namespace, sensor/Web mismatch, power/redundancy/thermal alarm or evidence failure, stop passive collection and preserve the first state. Close/revoke sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not change feeds/rails/PSUs, clear logs or retry insecurely; escalate exact PDB/feed/rail and record IDs to power/BMC owners.

source_conflict.reason: A versioned PDB namespace explicitly decides TEMP_PDB completeness and companion records; no thermal-only assumption or hidden numbered criteria remain.

blocked.reason: Complete standard reads, OEM namespace comparison, passive safety and recovery are defined; exact revision/topology/values are runtime Project Configuration.
